contract: Compute deficient target input keys once at entry to each recursive invocation.
Recompute candidate paths from live marking keys and the frozen deficient target keys.
Nested invocations compute their own target keys from their entry marking.
Pre-event candidate paths sort by length, source place name, then target place name.
Return before dependency exploration when the enabled-prefix phase enables the selected target.
reproduction: Decompress each reference gzip to JSON.
Run scripts/check-token-replay-native.py against the replay reference and scripts/check-petri-element-usage-native.py against the usage reference, supplying --reference, --native, and --output.
limits: Finite observations do not establish full parity.
Competing shortest-path choices can depend on net construction order; this checkpoint retains both insertion orders without normalizing their results.
Existing recursion and native resource guards remain in effect.
